metric_tolerance.note: Float pins carry a 1e-5 relative tolerance because they are derived from a power-flow solve, which is not bit-reproducible across BLAS builds and solver versions: the same commit drifts ~2e-6 relative between a developer machine and a GitHub runner. At 1e-6 absolute the fixtures passed locally and failed in CI. 1e-5 still catches any modelling change, which moves these values by percent, not by parts per million.
